name: value-utilities/transforms
description: Transform shorthand family. Each `translate-*`, `rotate-*`, `scale-*`, `skew-*` utility sets its `--tw-*` custom property and re-asserts the full `transform: <CSS_TRANSFORM_VALUE>` shorthand so the new value composes with whatever other transforms are applied on the element. Mirrors `corePlugins.js` `cssTransformValue` byte-for-byte. `transform`, `transform-cpu`, `transform-gpu` and `transform-none` are static utilities; `transform-gpu` swaps the leading `translate(...)` for `translate3d(...)` to force compositor onto the GPU. Negation is supported by all four families per `supportsNegativeValues: true` upstream.
